{
  "project_id": "P-UGA-IntegratedWaterMgmtDev",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Regional instability from the South Sudan conflict could disrupt project implementation and increase pressure on water services.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Monitor the security situation, adjust timelines as needed, and coordinate closely with UNHCR and other partners to secure alternative supply routes.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context – County Context: regional instability from South Sudan conflict may affect public services."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Large and continuing influx of refugees strains existing water resources and may exceed planned capacity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Integrate refugee settlements into water supply plans, secure additional funding for capacity expansion, and coordinate water trucking reduction with UNHCR.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context – County Context: 1 million South Sudanese refugees already in Uganda, pressure on water resources."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Climate change‑related floods and droughts could damage infrastructure and reduce water availability.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design climate‑resilient structures, implement catchment protection, buffer zones, and early‑warning systems for extreme events.",
      "evidence": "Technical – Climate Change Screening: identified extreme temperature, precipitation variability, floods and droughts as risks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Procurement unit staff lack experience with World Bank regulations and are over‑burdened, risking delays and non‑compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit procurement consultants, provide targeted training, and allocate dedicated staff for World Bank procurement processes.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – Key issues and risks: PDU staff have no experience with World Bank Procurement Regulations and heavy workload."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "The Project module of the Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS) is not operational, increasing risk of reporting errors.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize full IFMS module rollout, implement interim manual controls, and train finance staff on new procedures.",
      "evidence": "Financial Management – IFMS not fully operational; project module not yet operational, risk of errors."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Turnover of qualified staff in MWE and NWSC may lead to loss of institutional knowledge and implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Introduce retention incentives, succession planning, and knowledge‑transfer workshops for critical positions.",
      "evidence": "Financial Management – Turnover of qualified and experienced staff is noted."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Internal audit reports are not regularly shared with the World Bank, limiting fiduciary oversight.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a formal schedule for sharing audit findings with the Bank and assign a liaison officer.",
      "evidence": "Financial Management – Ministry internal audit reports are not shared regularly with the World Bank."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Incomplete geotechnical studies may cause design changes during construction, leading to cost overruns and delays.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct comprehensive geotechnical investigations before final design and include contingency allowances.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – Incomplete needs assessments and inadequate attention to geotechnical studies leading to design changes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Delays in preparing specifications, statements of requirements and Terms of Reference can postpone procurement.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set firm internal deadlines, assign a dedicated drafting team, and monitor progress through the Project Support Team.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – Delays in preparing specifications, statement of requirements, and ToRs by the User Departments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Limited capacity of domestic contractors for complex WSS works may force reliance on international firms, increasing costs.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Pre‑qualify contractors, encourage joint‑ventures, and provide capacity‑building workshops for local firms.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – Limited domestic contracting capacity to conduct projects of this nature, complexity, and scope."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Failure to maintain minimum environmental flow (EF) could degrade downstream ecosystems and trigger regulatory penalties.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate EF thresholds in design, install flow‑monitoring devices, and enforce compliance through regular inspections.",
      "evidence": "Environmental – Minimum EF may not be maintained at Namatala intake; risk to downstream users and ecological biota."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Labor influx associated with construction may increase gender‑based violence (GBV) against women and girls.",
      "category": "social",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement a Labor Influx Management Plan, code of conduct, community sensitisation, and robust grievance redress mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Labor influx – GBV risk highlighted; mitigation measures include code of conduct and training."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Long distances to water sources place a heavy burden on women and girls, increasing risk of GBV and limiting school attendance.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Locate new water points within 200 m of households, promote gender‑segregated facilities, and conduct hygiene education.",
      "evidence": "Gender Impact Study – Women walk long distances, leading to GBV and reduced school attendance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Handling of asbestos‑cement (AC) pipes poses health and environmental hazards if not managed properly.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Follow NEMA AC handling guidelines, train workers, and ensure safe disposal in designated facilities.",
      "evidence": "Environmental – Management measures for removal, packaging, transportation and disposal of asbestos waste required."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Chance finds of cultural heritage during construction could cause delays and require mitigation measures.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct pre‑construction archaeological surveys and include chance‑find procedures in ESMPs.",
      "evidence": "Environmental – Chance finds procedures included in ESMP for cultural resources."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Debt service on the IDA loan may consume a growing share of NWSC revenues, affecting financial sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Negotiate concessional repayment terms, align loan schedule with revenue growth, and improve cost recovery ratios.",
      "evidence": "Financial – Debt service could reach 1.4 % of total revenues after 2025."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "NWSC’s cost‑recovery tariffs are insufficient in non‑central regions, risking operating deficits.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Introduce region‑specific tariff adjustments, efficiency gains, and cross‑subsidy mechanisms to achieve full cost recovery.",
      "evidence": "Financial – Tariffs cover costs in Kampala but not in Eastern, Northern, Western, Southwestern regions."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Underestimation of construction costs may lead to budget overruns and schedule delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop detailed cost estimates, include contingency buffers, and conduct regular cost‑track reviews.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – Delayed construction and underestimation of the cost of works identified as a key risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Poor coordination among agencies could result in overlapping boreholes and contamination of water sources.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a joint coordination platform, share GIS data on existing wells, and enforce joint planning procedures.",
      "evidence": "Lessons Learned – Lack of coordination previously led to boreholes drilled too close to each other or to pit latrines."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Subsidiary agreement between the Ministry and NWSC not executed on time could delay fund disbursement.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Fast‑track legal review, assign a responsible officer, and monitor signing milestones through the Project Support Team.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants – Subsidiary Agreement required for NWSC to receive proceeds; effectiveness condition."
    }
  ]
}
